name: get_current_location
description: Get the user's approximate current location from the Google Geolocation API. Returns latitude, longitude, and accuracy.

name: get_time_zone
description: Get timezone information for a latitude/longitude at a concrete Unix timestamp.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds for the moment to evaluate, for example 1733428634.

name: get_current_datetime_for_location
description: Get the current local date and time for a latitude/longitude by combining the current UTC timestamp with Google timezone data.

name: get_lat_lng_from_address
description: Geocode a street address or place address into latitude and longitude using the Google Geocoding API.

address.description: Address to geocode, for example '1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA'.

name: search_by_text
description: Search Google Places by free-form text, such as restaurants, hotels, attractions, or a named place.

text_query.description: Free-form place search query, for example 'Steak in Canary Wharf, London' or 'hotels near UCL East, London'.

name: search_nearby
description: Search Google Places near a latitude/longitude with one or more included place types.

included_types.description: Google Places types to include, for example ['restaurant'], ['hotel'], or ['tourist_attraction'].

latitude.description: Center latitude for the nearby search.

longitude.description: Center longitude for the nearby search.

max_result_count.description: Maximum number of places to return.

name: compute_route
description: Compute route distance, duration, and transit step details where available between an origin and destination using Google Routes. The origin and destination must use the same location_input_type. travel_mode is required. Encoded polylines are intentionally not requested or returned.

origin.description: Origin location. Use a string for address or place id inputs, or an object with latitude and longitude for lat_lng inputs.

destination.description: Destination location. Use a string for address or place id inputs, or an object with latitude and longitude for lat_lng inputs.

location_input_type.description: How origin and destination are represented.

travel_mode.description: Required travel mode for the route. Use TRANSIT for public transport, WALK for walking legs, and DRIVE for car/taxi routes.

routing_preference.description: Optional routing preference for DRIVE only. Do not send it for WALK or TRANSIT.

compute_alternative_routes.description: Whether to ask Google Routes for alternative routes.

language_code.description: BCP-47 language code for route output, for example en-US.

units.description: Measurement units for the route response.

departure_time.description: Optional RFC3339 departure time, for example 2026-06-06T09:00:00Z. Especially useful for TRANSIT routes. Do not provide this together with arrival_time.

arrival_time.description: Optional RFC3339 arrival time, for example 2026-06-06T12:00:00Z. Especially useful for TRANSIT routes. Do not provide this together with departure_time.

name: search_flights
description: Search local demo flight candidates from database/transport/aero.json between two cities on a concrete travel date. Returns only a bounded filtered subset of matching candidates, never the whole flight database.

travel_date.description: Concrete ISO travel date, for example 2026-05-30.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching candidates to return. The tool also applies an internal hard cap to protect context size.
